title: Bible in a Year
note: Each day has four readings: the Old Testament (including the Apocrypha and other extra books in this edition, in this Bible’s book order), the Psalms, Proverbs, and the New Testament. On February 29 in a leap year, read the February 28 portion again, or use the day to catch up. The plan finishes on December 31.
